reuse.why: Introduces a shared getBudgetActionCategories that replaces the three copy-pasted category queries, reuses extractTagsFromText for the #fixed tag and getSheetValue/sum-amount for spending, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own inline rule set.

duplication.why: The eligibility rules (hidden/group-hidden with the include flag, #fixed group, saved template) are written twice: in getBudgetActionCategories (SQL plus filter) and again inline in copyPreviousMonth, and the income/tracking check stays repeated in every action loop.

placement.why: Eligibility helper and new action sit in budget/actions.ts and the method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings; the template rule is split between SQL in the helper and a JS truthiness check in copyPreviousMonth.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps: eligibility rules, the new action and its registration, the #fixed rule and the include flag, plus tests.

maintainability.why: A maintainer changing an exclusion rule must edit both the helper and copyPreviousMonth, whose template predicates already differ (goal_def IS NULL vs truthy goal_def), and the income rule remains outside the helper.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth (budget/actions.ts) re-applies hidden, #fixed and template rules inline over getBudgetData instead of using getBudgetActionCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The eligibility rules are expressed as SQL WHERE clauses plus a filter in getBudgetActionCategories and reshaped as early-return if-statements on prevBudget fields in copyPreviousMonth; the income/tracking check is repeated per action.

abstraction_drift.where: getBudgetActionCategories gains the includeHiddenCategories parameter (step 4); copyPreviousMonth bypasses it and re-implements the hidden/#fixed/template rules inline across steps 1, 3 and 4.
